data.title: bn-2vu: Define console.toml and deterministic cart compiler
data.description: Review manifest schema, path confinement, deterministic rendering, atomic/check behavior, CLI/report contracts, tests, and docs. Full just check passed.

data.body: The documented report contract says reports include the manifest and all canonical input paths, but the default `pretty` report emits neither: it only prints the project and an input count. Since this is the format most users receive, either print the manifest plus each canonical input here (and test it), or narrow the SPEC/guide claim explicitly to the text/JSON machine-readable formats.

Default-output confinement stops at the parent directory, but this read follows the final path component. If `build.output` is an in-project symlink to a file outside the project, `console build --check` reads that external file and may report `current`, contradicting the documented rule that the configured output resolves under the project root (and behaving differently from a normal build, whose adjacent rename replaces the symlink itself). Please reject a final-component symlink or canonicalize an existing default output and require it to remain under the canonical root before reading it; add a Unix regression covering an escaping output symlink.

data.reason: Configured output confinement is incomplete: --check follows an existing final-component output symlink outside the project root. Also align the default pretty report with the documented manifest/input-path contract (threads th-1d7vxq and th-35l4jr). Full just check passes.

data.body: Addressed in 0cd07b0: configured build.output now rejects an existing final-component symlink (and non-file leaf) before any --check read or normal write. Added a Unix CLI regression that exercises both --check and write modes and proves the external sentinel is neither read as current nor replaced. Focused tests and full just check pass.

Addressed in 0cd07b0: pretty output now prints the canonical manifest path and every canonical input path. Added a CLI regression covering manifest, Lua entry, and section input provenance. Focused tests, reference coverage, and full just check pass.

data.reason: Fixed in 0cd07b0: configured output leaves that are symlinks or non-files are rejected before check/read/write; Unix regression covers both modes and preserves the external target.
